expectations.text: spec.md has a `## Decisions` section that carries all six decisions from decisions.md without changing their meaning.
expectations.evidence: The six grill decisions are copied verbatim under 'Settled by the grill:', and the added 7-11 sit apart under 'Added while writing the PRD'.

expectations.text: spec.md has a `## Diagrams` section (placeholder is fine).
spec.md has a `## Design refs` section citing D4 and D5 and at least one architecture section (§4.x) and ADR 0005.

spec.md has a table of test rows in the form rule | test | unit or integration, covering at least: the 15-minute boundary (just inside vs just outside, with a pinned Clock), the non-author 403, the non-member 404, and the not-IN_STOCK 409.
expectations.evidence: 'Clock pinned at +14:59 and +15:00 → 201; at +15:01 → 409', another manager/admin → 403 NOT_ACTION_AUTHOR, non-member → 404, RESERVED/SOLD → 409, all integration.

expectations.text: spec.md has a numbered list of user stories in the form 'As a <actor>, I want <feature>, so that <benefit>', with at least five stories.
expectations.evidence: 24 numbered stories in the right form, though 23-24 are developer stories about implementation.

expectations.text: spec.md names the seams at which the feature is tested (e.g. the HTTP endpoint against Testcontainers Postgres and any pure rule in domain/), preferring existing seams.
expectations.evidence: 'One seam: the HTTP API, in integration tests against Testcontainers Postgres, with the Clock provider overridden … no new pure domain/ function', with prior-art health.spec.ts/db.spec.ts.

expectations.text: spec.md has an out-of-scope section listing at least two things deliberately not built (e.g. editing action type, deleting actions, corrections after the window).
expectations.evidence: '## Out of Scope' has 6 items, including type change, delete, correcting after 15 minutes, configurable window and a diff view.

claims.claim: schema.ts labels the append-only rule D19, but the architecture doc puts it under D4
claims.evidence: schema.ts line 141: '// Append-only (D19): rows are never updated or deleted'.

claims.claim: Known READ COMMITTED race on the supersession check is documented, not solved
claims.evidence: Further Notes states the limit and asks for a shortcut: comment, which matches the CLAUDE.md convention.

needs_review: Decisions 7-11 need confirming at the gate
workarounds: Seams check with the user replaced by the recommendation

suggestions.reason: Added decisions 7-11 and labelled them clearly. 7 (supersession) and 10 (precedence) are strengths, and 8 (root pointer) is reasonable. 11 is scope creep: it changes the existing POST /actions to write created_at from Clock, touching another feature. Story 3 ('add a note to an action logged without one') and the P3 'two corrections together → both 201' test also go beyond the typo-fix requirement.

Like with_skill, it has no `## Acceptance criteria` section even though the tester and code reviewer agents read one. It also has a separate Implementation Decisions section next to `## Decisions`, which splits decisions across two places.

eval_feedback.overall: Solid and complete. It keeps the grill decisions verbatim and apart from added ones, which is cleaner than with_skill. Slightly more scope growth outside the feature.
